title: Cross-provider handoff between live agents
footer: isolated demo state · namespace showcase-live · IDs are aliases
intro: A Codex agent and a Claude agent exchange mail through Relay.
outro: Both agents polled: Relay stored the mail, handed it out on read and marked it acknowledged on request. It started and woke nobody.

captions.caption: Retry with the same request key: same message, duplicate true. Nothing is stored twice.
The Codex agent sends to the Claude peer. The Claude agent is not even running yet.
The Claude agent starts later and polls: the mail was waiting. Reading twice acknowledges nothing.
Receipt is acknowledged explicitly, by the recipient only.
The answer goes back in the same conversation (reply-to the original message).
A later Codex session of the same peer polls and finds the answer.
Acknowledged once; the final inbox is empty.
